topPRs.title: fix(ci): add durable gateway transaction core
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
# Relates to

- Provider/custody readiness epic: #25025
- Gateway identity owner: #29763
- Delivery-tier/CAS authority owner: #29488
- Coordination parent: #25020

# Summary

This PR adds a deliberately dormant, staging-only gateway transaction core. It has no workflow, package-script, runtime caller, provider configuration, secret, or deployment route, so merging source alone cannot call Railway or change staging/production behavior.

The core now provides:

- an HMAC-authenticated logical journal with stable pagination, fork detection, lost-ack alias recovery, key rotation, and fail-closed current-`develop` fencing;
- immutable rollback-plan recovery with exact GitHub run/artifact identity, bounded ZIP parsing, archive digest/size/expiry checks, a strict three-file manifest, byte-for-byte local comparison, and adjacent re-attestation before OPEN publication;
- exact candidate/CLOSE receipt provenance from downloaded authoritative artifacts rather than local receipt claims;
- exact GitHub source-attempt terminal readback and prepared-OPEN run-list retention bound to the live `updated_at` terminal clock; GitHub's observed `completed_at: null` shape is accepted, and source authority is rechecked both before provider reads and immediately before rollback;
- Railway project-token, project, environment, service, complete-baseline terminality, history, active-topology, and provider-watermark attestation immediately before rollback;
- the live Boolean rollback contract, a full 690-second settlement horizon, at most R1/R2, no R3, and fail-closed attribution when an earlier ambiguous effect could explain a later restoration;
- production rejection and explicit dormant-source audit coverage.

# Current source

- Exact head: `625058972d4f351ce4275954dbec7a3ce5038d34`.
- Last fully validated base: `develop@f5a34d7e7422e7ed576fb98a9c6a9bbd6b3d1a45`.
- `develop` has since advanced beyond that validated base. Because this candidate is Draft/dormant behind the external #29488 authority blocker, it is not being churn-rebased; the current base is tracked in #25025, and a fresh rebase, exact-head validation, hosted CI, and independent review are required before any Ready transition.
- On its validated base, the first 13 commits remain range-diff equivalent across unrelated #30413, and the current 14th commit closes the review-confirmed live run-list timestamp boundary without adding a live caller.
- The PR intentionally remains **Draft**.

# Validation

At the exact head/base above:

- journal + reconciler contracts: **111/111 PASS, 523 assertions**;
- full repository verification: **376/376 tasks PASS**;
- script audit/self-test and secret-leak audit/self-test: **PASS**;
- Node syntax and `git diff --check`: **PASS**;
- Biome: exit 0, advisory warnings only in the already-large new test/core files;
- successive full-head reviews found malformed-envelope, duplicate-key, missing provider-field, moving-baseline, missing exact-source-terminal-readback, raw provider-ID output, and live exact-attempt/run-list timestamp gaps; the current head closes each with fail-closed negative tests that prove zero provider mutation;
- independent full exact-head adversarial and security reviews of this head: **PASS, zero additional P0-P3**;
- hosted exact-head [run 33729020538](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/33729020538): **5/5 PASS**.

The local, hosted, and independent-review evidence above all ran on this exact head.

# Blocking security boundaries

The remaining blocking boundary is:

- **P1 structural — issue comments cannot be authoritative.** Authentication detects edited records and visible forks, but reconstructing the head only from currently visible comments cannot distinguish a genuine clear state from a deleted/truncated authenticated tail or OPEN. #29488 must supply an append/CAS authority outside mutable comments, with deletion/force-update resistance, concurrency exclusion, staging isolation, recovery/rotation, readback, and negative canaries. Durable owner handoff: https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/issues/29488#issuecomment-5520656842.
The correctable findings are closed in source: all previous-key graph work precedes the final exact rekey/current-`develop` authority boundary immediately before POST; GitHub/Railway failures are classified and redacted at source; all JSON authority inputs reject decoded duplicate object keys before native parsing; GraphQL success envelopes and required provider fields are fail-closed; every immutable baseline row must remain terminal; exact source-attempt and run-list retention bind GitHub's populated `updated_at` rather than its null `completed_at`; raw provider IDs are not written to stdout; Actions annotations are allowlisted and encode `%`, CR, and LF. Race, live-source-schema, malformed/duplicate-envelope, source substitution, transition-state, and secret/ID/body/argv/stderr/CRLF injection tests pass. Fresh full-head reviews passed with zero additional P0-P3.

Comments may remain a redacted mirror; they cannot be the sole head authority. Passing tests or CI do not waive any blocker.

# Review guidance

Start with `packages/scripts/gateway-webhook-transaction-journal.mjs`, then `packages/scripts/gateway-webhook-reconcile.mjs` and their adjacent tests. The narrow audit allowlist is intentional only while this precursor is dormant.

# Deploy notes

This PR intentionally stays Draft until the #29488 authority exists, this core consumes it, the full exact-head security review passes, hosted CI is green, review threads are resolved, and formal current-head approval is recorded. Maintainers may then make the normal merge decision. Any live ruleset/ref/environment action, workflow dispatch, Railway rollback, provider operation, or deployment remains separately authorized at action time.

No provider message, provider/OAuth configuration, secret, database query, workflow dispatch, deployment, control-plane, sandbox, or production mutation occurred while preparing or validating this candidate.

topPRs.title: fix(cloud): complete paid-call standing and admission safety
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

This integration PR lands the three already-reviewed latency and account-standing fixes together against the current exact base:

- durable idempotent ElevenLabs voice-clone receipts, ambiguous settlement, safe public failure vocabulary, and reconciliation visibility
- one-read/no-readback standing enforcement before active Twilio, Blooio, WhatsApp, and provider-capable A2A dispatch
- idempotent retry for transient cold inference rate-admission failures, with a stable operation deadline that can never double-consume after receipt expiry

It supersedes #30365, #30380, and #30388 only to avoid three more base-advance/revalidation cycles. Their reviews and focused evidence remain linked here.

Closes #30357
Closes #30358
Closes #30387

## Evidence

- Voice clone: 11 focused tests, 78 assertions; PGlite receipt/fence/concurrency tests; Cloud API typecheck; Biome
- Outbound: standing 2/2, router 19/19, A2A 7/7, isolated Blooio 6/6; shared typecheck; Cloud API build
- Rate admission: unit 50/50 (340 assertions), Miniflare 17/17 (69 assertions), full repository verify 376/376 plus audits
- Independent rate review reproduced and then verified fixes for greater-than-64 interleaving, elapsed receipt expiry, lost acknowledgements, 200 replay, and 429 replay
- Paid-boundary audit found no remaining active source-level bypass, duplicate standing-cache read, cache write/readback latency, unsafe public denial reason, or missing structured boundary logging

## Runtime contract

Paid/provider dispatch resolves standing before credentials or provider I/O. Warm standing uses exactly one cache read. A cache miss uses one authoritative SQL query and schedules one projection write without reading it back. Denials return a closed safe reason and emit detailed structured no-dispatch context. Post-dispatch ambiguity settles unknown or enters durable reconciliation rather than refunding work that may have been accepted.

topPRs.title: fix(cloud): settle Dedicated Headscale registration identity
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## What changed

- diagnose the exact failed Dedicated canary across its Docker process, Tailscale socket, Headscale REST inventory, tags, route, and active peer identity without exposing private addresses or credentials
- select the unique canonical tailnet IPv4 from Headscale's unordered repeated address field instead of assuming address zero is IPv4
- retain the exact observed Headscale node ID in the replacement cleanup locator before Docker/Headscale address binding, so a mismatch cannot strand an offline peer or poison the next deterministic-name provision
- lock both behaviors with real integration/provider-path regressions

## Why

Fresh signed-in Dedicated canary `33712952322` reached a running agent process and registered an exact tagged Headscale peer, but provisioning still reported missing ingress. Follow-up diagnostics proved the API/CLI peer existed and that its assigned peer address differed from the stale database observation. The provider then dropped the observed node ID when final address binding failed; Docker cleanup proceeded while the Headscale identity remained orphaned.

Headscale's v0.28 node contract exposes `ip_addresses` as a repeated field and does not promise IPv4-first ordering. Treating element zero as the routable IPv4 turns a valid IPv6-first registration into a false registration miss. The repaired selector accepts exactly one canonical CGNAT IPv4 and fails closed on zero or ambiguity.

Closes the remaining registration-settlement and orphan-cleanup defects tracked in #29341.

## Evidence

- `bun test packages/cloud/shared/src/lib/services/headscale-integration.test.ts packages/cloud/shared/src/lib/services/__tests__/docker-sandbox-replacement-cleanup.test.ts`: 104 tests, 466 assertions, 0 failures
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/shared typecheck`: pass
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/shared lint`: pass
- `bun run verify`: pass (376 Turbo tasks plus repository audit gates)
- diagnostic runs: `33715419078`, `33715767150`, `33716302381`
- exact stale-canary cleanup: `33716432757`, pass, `possibleOrphan=false`
- exact-source staging worker deployment: `33716850524` (running at PR creation; merge remains gated on terminal result)

## Scope / invariants

- signed-in app/Cloud traffic remains `dedicated-always`; no Shared fallback was added
- Shared remains limited to public or explicitly Shared ingress
- warm pool remains protected-off so it cannot conceal cold-path behavior
- tenant DB creation/migration remains fail-closed and was repeatedly ready in the failed canaries; this repair is at the Headscale settlement boundary

topPRs.title: fix(cloud): retain voice clone provider receipts
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Closes #30357

## What changed
- adds an organization/user-scoped durable `Idempotency-Key` fence before pricing, billing admission, uploads, or provider dispatch
- hashes the complete canonical request (including each audio file) so same-payload retries replay safely and different-payload key reuse returns `409 idempotency_conflict`
- stores the completed response for exact successful replay and returns the existing job on in-flight or reconciliation retries without duplicate billing/provider work
- synchronously persists append-only ElevenLabs step receipts and the provider voice ID at each irreversible boundary
- classifies ambiguous post-dispatch transport failures with `VoiceCloneSubmissionUnknownError extends ElizaError` (`VOICE_CLONE_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN`, provider/step context, cause, severity)
- preserves R2/sample/job evidence and conservatively calls `settleUnknown()` whenever provider acceptance is possible
- exposes `reconciliation_required` jobs through the authenticated voice-jobs endpoint as an explicit manual recovery queue, including provider state, step, and voice locator
- emits tenant/job/provider/step/state/voice-locator structured error context without request audio or API keys

## Verification
- `bun test packages/cloud/api/v1/voice/clone/route.standing.test.ts` — 7 pass, including different-payload conflict, timeout-after-acceptance same-key retry, and later-step failure
- `bun test packages/cloud/api/elevenlabs/voices/jobs/route.reconciliation.test.ts` — 1 pass; proves reconciliation-required jobs remain public to the authenticated manual queue
- `bun test packages/cloud/shared/src/db/repositories/__tests__/user-voices-provider-receipts.pglite.test.ts --coverage-reporter=lcov` — 2 pass against real PGlite; proves receipts and tenant-scoped atomic idempotency fencing
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/shared typecheck` — pass
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/api typecheck` — pass, including router contract and Worker dry-run bundle
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/api build` — pass
- package Biome checks, migration check, and `git diff --check` — pass
- `bun run verify` — pass (376/376 Turbo tasks plus repository audits)

## Evidence
- Database artifact: real PGlite rows retain provider receipts, `elevenlabs_voice_id`, explicit reconciliation state, and one tenant-scoped job per idempotency key.
- Live ElevenLabs mutation: N/A — intentionally not invoked from a PR test because clone creation is paid and irreversible; adversarial provider transport behavior is deterministic at the route boundary.
- UI screenshots/video: N/A — no UI changes.

topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Closes #30386

## Summary
- persist the successful deployed browser chat trace, allowlisted `Server-Timing`, preforward breakdown, and SHA-256 provider request correlation in the uploaded staging receipt
- capture the actual chat response origin and require it to equal the staging Dedicated reference binding API origin before evidence is written
- require all Dedicated auth, ownership, routing, proxy-dispatch, and total timing metrics
- emit one always-on, closed-schema warning only after authenticated ownership/routing completes for a valid traced chat request; unauthenticated 401/403 callers and non-chat probes emit nothing, while successful and warming post-auth attempts remain observable
- preserve upstream timing/correlation headers and avoid nginx or agent-router changes

## Verification
- app correlation/evidence tests: 7 passed
- Dedicated proxy unit tests: 56 passed
- Pages authority, staging receipt, and deployed workflow tests: 27 passed
- Cloud API typecheck, 708-route contract audit, and Worker dry-run: passed
- app typecheck: passed
- Biome check for all 10 touched files: passed
- exact PR-range gitleaks scan: passed
- `git show --check`: passed

Regression coverage rejects mismatched response/reference origins, injected secret-shaped metric names, missing Dedicated metrics, shared or invalid runtime bindings, and unauthenticated traced 401/403 logging. It retains authenticated warming timing logs and proves the uploaded receipt carries the sanitized correlation envelope.

## Live evidence boundary
The protected deployed Playwright run requires a deployed revision plus the protected staging access key and authenticated account. Browser evidence schema v3 and staging receipt v4 preserve the safe cross-provider join data needed for Cloudflare/Railway correlation.
